value.rationale: The result closes the intrinsic \(q=2\) and \(1<q<2\) gap of a sharp class-equivalence theorem for natural sparse coefficient weights. The obstruction to the former proof is a real additive collision on dyadic spectra, and the new shifted compact-compression mechanism removes it without altering the weight threshold. It covers arbitrary Hadamard sets rather than a manufactured special family, while explicitly crediting the existing reverse implication and necessity ideas.
